identity.what_it_is: A small hooked cove and low-rise beach resort on the western coast of Ibiza, in the municipality of Sant Josep de Sa Talaia.
identity.where: Sant Josep de Sa Talaia municipality, western Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain (38.91306N, 1.22389E).
identity.warnings: EN Wikipedia and most tourism sites spell it 'Cala Vadella'; the official Sant Josep municipal site uses the Catalan 'Cala Vedella' (matches this slug); same place, both spellings verified, no near-duplicate beach found elsewhere.

spike_candidates.statement: In May 2025, Cala Vedella owners asked Sant Josep to formally take over an urbanización over 90% built, 52 years after its 1973 development plan was approved.
spike_candidates.tension: A cove marketed as a calm family beach sits behind a residential development that has never been legally regularized and is tangled in a criminal probe that led to a former mayor's detention.

spike_candidates.statement: Cala Vedella's own wastewater treatment plant, sized roughly 50 years ago, was still overloaded in summer as of 2018-2019 and the town hall studied expropriating it.
spike_candidates.tension: The infrastructure serving a Blue Flag family beach is a decades-old private plant nobody can legally repair or take over quickly.

spike_candidates.statement: A 2025 parking crackdown at nearby Cala d'Hort pushed illegally parked cars onto the Cala Vedella access road, and neither the Guardia Civil nor local police would claim jurisdiction to fine them.
spike_candidates.tension: Enforcement authorities disagree over who is responsible, so the overflow-parking problem just relocates from beach to beach unresolved.

facts.fact: Cala Vadella (Cala Vedella in Catalan) is a small cove and beach resort on the western coast of Ibiza.
facts.quote: cala vadella (cala vedella in catalan ) is a small cove and beach resort on the western seaboard of the spanish island of ibiza .

facts.fact: The resort is 14.5 miles (23.3 km) west of Ibiza Town, and the nearest village, Sant Josep de Sa Talaia, is 5.3 miles (8.5 km) east of it.
facts.quote: the beach resort is in the municipality of sant josep de sa talaia and is 14.5 miles (23.3 km) [ 2 ] west of the town of ibiza town .

facts.fact: As of 2012, Cala Vadella was one of 12 Blue Flag beaches on Ibiza.
facts.quote: in 2012 cala vadella is one of the 12 blue flag [ 3 ] beaches on ibiza.

facts.fact: The north side of the cove juts out to a headland called Es' Torraci, which has its own small satellite beach called Sa Torrasa.
facts.quote: the north side of the cove juts out to a small headland called es' torraci which itself has a small inlet on it north side with a small satellite beach called sa torrasa .

facts.fact: A small beach on the inlet's southern side once hosted an illegal bar/nightclub; its concrete dance floor remnants remain near the water.
facts.quote: which was once home to an illegal bar come nightclub, long since closed but the concrete remnants of the dance floor still remain near the water

facts.fact: The cove's swimming and snorkelling is sometimes marred by infestations of stinging jellyfish.
facts.quote: however, the swimming and snorkelling experience is marred, in some years, by infestations of stinging jellyfish .

facts.fact: The main beach is patrolled by lifeguards during the summer season.
facts.quote: during the summer season the main beach is patrolled by lifeguards .

facts.fact: There is parking behind the beach for 250 cars, including bays reserved for disabled drivers with a European blue badge.
facts.quote: behind the beach there is parking for 250 cars including a small amount of allocated parking bays for disabled drivers displaying a european blue badge .

facts.fact: The recommended route is the EI-700 road out of Sant Josep de Sa Talaia towards Sant Antoni, following signs to the cove.
facts.quote: the best route to reach cala vedella is to take the ei-700 out of sant josep de sa talaia towards sant antoni .

facts.fact: Wikidata records the cove/beach at 275 metres long and 30 metres wide.
facts.quote: length 275 metre

facts.fact: Ibiza Spotlight gives the same figure as Wikidata: 275 metres long and 30-70 metres wide.
facts.quote: size : 275 metres long, 30-70 metres wide

facts.fact: Spain's official tourism site instead lists the beach at 200 m long and 45 m wide, semi-urban development.
facts.quote: length: 200 m width: 45 m

facts.fact: Spain.info classifies the beach's sand as white with calm swimming conditions.
facts.quote: type of beach composition: sand type of sand: white swimming conditions: calm waters

facts.fact: The nearest marina, Puerto Deportivo de Coralmar, is 7 km from the beach.
facts.quote: marina: puerto deportivo de coralmar distance to beach: 7 km.

facts.fact: The beach's EU bathing-water is registered under EIONET Bathing Water ID ES531M0481209.
facts.quote: eionet bathing water id es531m0481209

facts.fact: The official Sant Josep tourism site puts the beach 22 km from Eivissa and 9 km from Sant Josep de Sa Talaia.
facts.quote: distances: 22 km from eivissa and 9 km from sant josep de sa talaia.
facts.source_title: Playa de Cala Vedella - Sant Josep tourism

facts.fact: Access is via a left turnoff on the outskirts of Sant Josep at kilometer 13 of the Eivissa-Sant Josep road, along a paved road.
facts.quote: access from the left turnoff located on the outskirts of sant josep de sa talaia, at kilometer 13 on the eivissa-sant josep de sa talaia road, following the appropriate signs along a paved road.
facts.source_title: Playa de Cala Vedella - Sant Josep tourism

facts.fact: The official site confirms a lifeguard service operates during the high season.
facts.quote: lifeguard service during the high season
facts.source_title: Playa de Cala Vedella - Sant Josep tourism

facts.fact: The cove's shape gives it panoramic views of the islet of s'Espartar.
facts.quote: this beach, due to its shape, has great charm and offers views of the islet of s'espartar.
facts.source_title: Playa de Cala Vedella - Sant Josep tourism

facts.fact: The Cala Vedella partial development plan was approved in 1973 and its urbanizing agent, UMSA, never completed the legal instruments needed to legalize it.
facts.quote: en el año 1973 se aprobó el plan parcial de cala vedella.
facts.source_title: Cala Vedella: nido de irregularidades urbanísticas

facts.fact: A 2005 building license (363/2005) allowed 61 homes at Port d'es Nebot; a later agreement reduced this to 12 luxury villas.
facts.quote: la licencia 363/2005 permitía hacer 61 viviendas en este rincón de la costa de cala vedella.
facts.source_title: Cala Vedella: nido de irregularidades urbanísticas

facts.fact: In October 2019 Sant Josep town hall ordered a halt to the Vadella 24 housing project and opened disciplinary proceedings over unlicensed works.
facts.quote: el ayuntamiento de sant josep ordenó en octubre de 2019 su paralización y posteriormente inició expediente de disciplina urbanística
facts.source_title: Cala Vedella: nido de irregularidades urbanísticas

facts.fact: The Cala Vedella wastewater treatment plant is an obsolete, undersized installation owned by the urbanizing company UMSA.
facts.quote: una instalación obsoleta e insuficiente para la zona que pertenece a la empresa urbanizadora, umsa.
facts.source_title: Cala Vedella: nido de irregularidades urbanísticas

facts.fact: In a filing dated 30 April 2025, owners state the Cala Vedella urbanización is more than 90% built out with fully operational basic services.
facts.quote: la urbanización cala vadella está urbanizada en más de un 90% , con servicios básicos como agua, alumbrado, alcantarillado, recogida de residuos y red eléctrica plenamente operativos y en uso.
facts.source_title: 20 años de parálisis: propietarios de Cala Vadella piden que se acabe la urbanización

facts.fact: Since 2007 the town hall stopped processing major building licenses for the remaining 20% of undeveloped Cala Vedella parcels.
facts.quote: desde 2007 el ayuntamiento dejó de tramitar licencias de obras mayores en el 20% restante de las parcelas
facts.source_title: 20 años de parálisis: propietarios de Cala Vadella piden que se acabe la urbanización

facts.fact: Sant Josep's public participation process for its new general urban plan (PGOU) closed with 241 submitted contributions.
facts.quote: que se cerró con un total de 241 aportaciones, según informó el consistorio la semana pasada.
facts.source_title: 20 años de parálisis: propietarios de Cala Vadella piden que se acabe la urbanización

facts.fact: The Cala Vedella case has included the detention of former Sant Josep mayor Ángel Luis Guerrero over a SEPRONA investigation into territorial-planning offenses.
facts.quote: la detención del ex alcalde socialista ángel luis guerrero , a partir de una investigación a instancias del seprona por posibles delitos contra la ordenación del territorio
facts.source_title: 20 años de parálisis: propietarios de Cala Vadella piden que se acabe la urbanización

facts.fact: In November 2019 the town hall's deputy mayor said it was studying expropriating the private Cala Vedella treatment plant, since it could not formally accept unfinished works.
facts.quote: no podemos hacer una recepción de las obras porque no están acabadas; lo que estamos mirando jurídicamente y lo que habrá que hacer es expropiar la propia planta de depuración.
facts.source_title: El ayuntamiento de Sant Josep estudia cómo expropiar la depuradora de Cala Vedella

facts.fact: In April 2019, expansion works on the Cala Vedella treatment plant were confirmed delayed past that summer pending a major-works license.
facts.quote: las obras de ampliación de la depuradora de agua de cala vedella no podrán llevarse a cabo antes de este verano.
facts.source_title: La ampliación de la depuradora de Cala Vedella no estará a punto este verano

facts.fact: At a June 2018 council session, officials noted the Cala Vedella treatment plant was sized roughly 50 years earlier and needed complete renovation.
facts.quote: una depuradora dimensionada hace 50 años y que requería una modificación y renovación completa
facts.source_title: La depuradora de Cala Vedella se remodelará este invierno para solventar sus deficiencias

facts.fact: On 10 September 2026, emergency crews recovered a car that rolled over after leaving the Cala Vedella access road overnight, with no serious injuries.
facts.quote: los equipos de emergencia y asistencia vial han procedido en la mañana de este jueves al rescate de un vehículo que sufrió una salida de vía durante la pasada noche en la carretera de cala vedella
facts.source_title: Rescatan un vehículo volcado tras salirse de una vía de Cala Vedella

facts.fact: An August 2025 report found that parking restrictions at nearby Cala d'Hort pushed illegally parked cars onto the Cala Vedella road, with Guardia Civil and local police disputing who is responsible for fining them.
facts.quote: fuentes de la policía local señalaron a unos vecinos de la zona que la regulación del estacionamiento en la carretera de cala vedella «es competencia de la guardia civil», mientras que desde el instituto armado afirmaron que «corresponde a la policía local».
facts.source_title: El control del aparcamiento en Cala d'Hort desplaza el problema a la carretera de Cala Vedella

facts.fact: A January 2021 Urbanitae crowdfunded project built 12 luxury villas 500 metres from Cala Vadella beach and 18 km from Ibiza airport, developed by Azur Estates.
facts.quote: esta promoción residencial se localiza en ibiza, en el municipio de san josé, a tan solo 500 metros de la playa de cala vadella, y a 18 km del aeropuerto de ibiza.
facts.source_title: Cala Vadella: éxito en nuestro primer proyecto en Baleares - Urbanitae blog

facts.fact: The Urbanitae Cala Vadella loan, backed by a ticket of 650,000 euros from 227 investors, delivered a final return of 9.1%, with capital repaid in April 2022.
facts.quote: un total de 227 inversores participaron en la financiación de la promoción, cuyo capital e intereses se devolvieron en abril de 2022.
facts.source_title: Cala Vadella: éxito en nuestro primer proyecto en Baleares - Urbanitae blog

facts.fact: Vadella Beach Bar, run by Jordi and Coco directly on Cala Vedella beach, holds the Sabors d'Eivissa local-produce seal.
facts.quote: vadella beach bar es el restaurante de jordi y coco a pie de playa en la tranquila cala vadella, en sant josep de sa talaia.

facts.fact: Ca Na Sofía, on Cala Vedella beach, is listed among Sant Josep's Sabors d'Eivissa restaurants for its Mediterranean rice and fresh-fish dishes.
facts.quote: ca na sofía cala vedella. ubicado en la encantadora playa de cala vedella, este restaurante combina lo mejor de la cocina mediterránea con un enfoque innovador.

facts.fact: On 7 February 2026, a storm brought winds of up to 74 km/h to Ibiza, with video of rough seas recorded at Cala Vadella.
facts.quote: ibiza registra vientos de hasta 74 km/h este sábado por el temporal vídeo del mar en cala vadella.

facts.fact: In August 2022, the PP party publicly demanded answers from Sant Josep about water conditions in the Cala Vadella area, referencing the water treatment plant.
facts.quote: el pp exige respuestas a sant josep sobre el estado del agua en la zona de cala vadella imagen de archivo de la depuradora de agua de cala vedella.

facts.fact: In August 2021, a Cala Vedella resident was blocked into her home for at least four hours by an illegally parked car, unable to get to work.
facts.quote: un mínimo de cuatro horas tuvo que estar una vecina de cala vedella sin poder ir a trabajar por culpa de un coche que bloqueó su vivienda al aparcar en zona prohibida

facts.fact: The resort is 10 minutes' drive from the village of San José, which holds a Saturday ecological food and craft market in summer.
facts.quote: spotlight tip combine a day in cala vadella with a visit to the charming white village of san josé . in summer, there is an ecological food and craft market each saturday.

facts.fact: A regular bus service to Cala Vadella runs during summer months, starting in Ibiza Town via Sant Josep de Sa Talaia.
facts.quote: during the summer months there is a regular bus service [ 6 ] which starts in ibiza town via sant josep de sa talaia .

facts.fact: The rocky sides of the shallow, crystal-clear cove make for good snorkelling conditions.
facts.quote: the rocky sides to the cove can be a good environment for snorkelling .

recency.newest_item: On 10 September 2026 a car rolled over after leaving the Cala Vedella access road overnight; emergency crews recovered it the next morning with no serious injuries reported.
